target_customer: Home service contractors, such as plumbing, HVAC and electrical businesses, that run on ServiceTitan
problem: Contractors lack real time analytics, so budgets go stale. Bluelight builds revenue plans around operational drivers and updates morning huddle numbers automatically.
product_category: Analytics and revenue planning for home services

founders.name: Alex Dixon
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no education or prior employers. Employer details appear in an unopened aggregator snippet, so not recorded.

founders.name: Stewart Lamke
founders.background_notes: YC page says he worked in revenue management and strategy, without naming employers.

competitors.name: Jobber
competitors.what: Field service management platform for home service professionals with reporting, adjacent rather than a pure analytics rival
competitors.traction_then: Over 100,000 users at the time of its raise
competitors.funding_then: 60 million dollars equity round in January 2021

competitors.name: Workiz
competitors.what: Field service platform with call tracking and attribution, adjacent to analytics

technical_complexity.rationale: Data pipelines and dashboards on top of the ServiceTitan API. Hard parts were data modeling per trade and keeping figures current.

defensibility.rationale: Depends on access to ServiceTitan data and could be copied by ServiceTitan or by BI tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. Bluelight is now a Nexstar strategic partner and focuses on ServiceTitan operators; no source describes ServiceTitan copying it.

market_need_then: Home service businesses grew fast and spent heavily on software, but spreadsheets drove budgeting. Jobber reported its users grew to 100,000 by January 2021.

branding.domain_note: Uses usebluelight.com, with a use prefix.

identity.voice_and_tone: Bold and direct, for example Your budget is stale. We fix it.

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated companies use the Bluelight name and brand searches returned them rather than this company.

pivots.why: Inferred from the YC tagline versus current site; no source states a pivot or date.

outcome_analysis: Bluelight appears active in 2026 with named customers, a recent case study and a Nexstar partnership, but no public funding beyond small amounts and no acquisition were found. It narrowed from general trades analytics to ServiceTitan operators, which gives focus but dependence on one platform. Scale is not public.
notes: CB Insights lists 220 thousand dollars over 3 rounds with WeFunder, Y Combinator and Born Capital investors; aggregator only, so no rounds recorded. The brand effect hurt is a judgment from name collisions in search results, weakly supported. Jobber and Workiz are adjacent field service platforms, not direct analytics competitors; Datacube (live KPI dashboards from ServiceTitan data) has no dated source. Founded year 2020 is from an aggregator. The brand search returned unrelated Bluelight companies.
